newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SHARES GAIN PACE, BOURSE CONFIDENCE UP.
newsitem.headline: SHARES GAIN PACE, BOURSE CONFIDENCE UP.

text.p: Estonian share prices gained in
Monday early trade with dealers saying confidence was stronger
and that the higher prices would hold for the day.
Volume on the main list at 0900 GMT was 41.1 million kroons
with the Talse online index 1.47 percent higher at 266.81.
"Prices finished higher on Friday and local investors had a
chance to think it over on the break and placed buy orders for
the start of trading," one dealer said.
"The bullish feel could last for as long as the week, but
beyond that, with the coming summer holidays, it is too hard to
predict," another dealer said.
The market had been gaining steam with higher liquidity and
expectations of good half results and revised profit estimates.
Uhispank saw trade of 14.7 million kroons to be the most
active stock for a higher spread of 54.50/54.90 kroons.
"There is good interest in most banking stocks, but I can't
see any specific news to promote Uhis above other stocks,"
another dealer said.
Most banking stocks gained in morning trade.
Hansapank saw trade of 6.8 million kroons of
shares to move higher on a bid/ask of 142.80/143.45 kroons
compared to 139.65 kroons.
On the free market, Norma was most the most active
stock with 2.8 million kroons traded for a spread of 73.25/74.40
kroons compared to 71.30 kroons.
"The results of its five month profit (52.3 million kroons)
for Norma were as expected and it should support the stock's
price," another trader said.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202/1,
